summary: Inert stub shadowing the `ca_certificates` import name
details: The distribution `changes-lxc-wrapper` ships a trivial package whose top-level import name is `ca_certificates`, creating a mismatch between the distribution name and the import namespace it occupies. The shipped `__init__.py` only defines a `__version__` constant and an `info()` function returning a placeholder string. There are no install or build hooks, no top-level import-time side effects, no subprocess or network activity, and no credential or filesystem access. Package metadata is placeholder (`Your Name` / `you@example.com`). No installer-side harmful behavior is present in the shipped code; the only concern is namespace shadowing on the common `ca_certificates` import name.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
